summary: Inspectors hear former patients’ accounts before asking administrators how the wards operate.
realLife: Federal inspection teams spoke with former patients and local residents before visiting hospitals to assess segregation.
gates: An on-site compliance visit is pending.
inGame: needs: consented interviews linked to a facility and a compliance inspection.

turns.what: Neighbors describe the admissions practice and a former patient asks to speak privately.
turns.pulledBy: The patient fears being identified in a small community.
turns.writesBack: The team records the patient's account separately with restricted attribution.

turns.what: A former patient contacts the reviewers after their visit.
turns.pulledBy: The patient learns about the inquiry from a neighbor.
turns.writesBack: The case file gains a dated follow-up interview.
